func isJSON(fl FieldLevel) bool {
	field := fl.Field()

	if field.Kind() == reflect.String {
		val := field.String()
		return json.Valid([]byte(val))
	}

	panic(fmt.Sprintf("Bad field type %T", field.Interface()))
